Advance Notice of Publication of Splunk Security Advisories - September 2026
Advisory ID:
SVD-2026-0901
Published:
2026-09-09
Last Updated:
2026-09-10
Description
The advisories planned for September 16, 2026 are delayed until October 7, 2026. Splunk will now publish advisories to disclose security vulnerabilities for the following Splunk products on October 7th:
Splunk Enterprise
Splunk Universal Forwarder
Splunk Add-on for Amazon Web Services
Splunk MCP Server
To remediate vulnerabilities to be disclosed on October 7, 2026, Splunk strongly recommends that customers apply the latest software version available for download for those products.
Changelog
2026-09-10: Updated the disclosure date to October 7, 2026. The advisories are delayed from Sept 16th to October 7th.
